MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot feels like a useful next addition because Alexa voice control complements my existing Fire TV viewing setup.",
    "The Echo Show also fits my interest in connected home devices, although I would try one Alexa speaker before adding a display."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV sticks repeat something I already have; another 4K stick feels redundant, and an HD stick offers little benefit alongside my 4K setup.",
    "Earbuds, headphones, adapters, and a tablet address needs I have not expressed. My recent interest in electronics does not mean I currently want portable audio or entertainment.",
    "The large hard drive has a possible connection to recording video, but that connection alone does not give me a reason to need 16TB of storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been treated as a reason to buy more streaming devices, rather than evidence that this need is already covered.",
    "My interest in home electronics seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in electronics and accessories regardless of their purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more interested in additions that give my existing home setup a useful new capability, such as convenient voice control.",
    "Similar Alexa devices are alternatives for me right now: I would choose the fourth-generation Dot first, rather than also choosing the older Dot or a smart display.",
    "A related product still needs to solve a current problem; recording video does not by itself establish a need for extra storage, and owning electronics does not establish a connection problem."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected home interests but often confused useful additions with duplicate devices and loosely related electronics."
}
